name: microservices-nodejs-b2b-b2c
description: Microservices API for B2B/B2C multivendor marketplace

scripts.start: npm run start:gateway & npm run start:auth & npm run start:products & npm run start:transactions & npm run start:messaging & npm run start:notifications & npm run start:advertising & npm run start:ticketing & npm run start:system & npm run start:analytics & npm run start:shipping & npm run start:recommender
scripts.stop: pkill -f 'node.*auth' & pkill -f 'node.*products' & pkill -f 'node.*transactions' & pkill -f 'node.*messaging' & pkill -f 'node.*notifications' & pkill -f 'node.*advertising' & pkill -f 'node.*ticketing' & pkill -f 'node.*system' & pkill -f 'node.*analytics' & pkill -f 'node.*shipping' & pkill -f 'python.*recommender'
scripts.db:up: npm run db:up:auth && npm run db:up:products && npm run db:up:transactions && npm run db:up:messaging && npm run db:up:notifications && npm run db:up:advertising && npm run db:up:ticketing && npm run db:up:system && npm run db:up:analytics && npm run db:up:shipping && npm run db:up:recommender
scripts.db:down: npm run db:down:auth && npm run db:down:products && npm run db:down:transactions && npm run db:down:messaging && npm run db:down:notifications && npm run db:down:advertising && npm run db:down:ticketing && npm run db:down:system && npm run db:down:analytics && npm run db:down:shipping && npm run db:down:recommender
scripts.test: npm run test:auth && npm run test:products && npm run test:transactions && npm run test:messaging && npm run test:notifications && npm run test:advertising && npm run test:ticketing && npm run test:system && npm run test:analytics && npm run test:shipping && npm run test:recommender
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:gateway && npm run install:auth && npm run install:products && npm run install:transactions && npm run install:messaging && npm run install:notifications && npm run install:advertising && npm run install:ticketing && npm run install:system && npm run install:analytics && npm run install:shipping && npm run install:recommender
